resources.name: CNAT API
resources.description: Complete CNAT API collection. Activate the CNAT Local environment, run Login, copy the token into the env variable.

resources.description: Returns Sanctum Bearer token. Copy token to environment.

resources.description: WARNING: Wipes all period dates for the user.

resources.description: Creates Student AND Admission in one transaction.
